notes.summary: Fixed OAuth redirect loop after sign-in
notes.approach: Traced the callback and found the session cookie was set for the wrong domain
notes.outcome: Sign-in completes and returns to the original page
notes.learning: Set the cookie domain from the public hostname, not the internal service name

notes.summary: Postgres migration blocked by an exclusive table lock
notes.approach: Added the constraint as not valid, then validated it in a separate transaction
notes.learning: Validate new constraints after the first transaction commits

notes.summary: Websocket reconnect test failed intermittently in CI
notes.approach: Replaced fixed sleeps with a wait on the reconnect event
notes.learning: Never sleep for a fixed time when an event can be awaited

notes.summary: Docker image rebuilds were slow because dependencies reinstalled every time
notes.approach: Copied the lockfile and installed dependencies before copying source
notes.outcome: Cached layer reused; builds dropped from six minutes to one
notes.learning: Order Dockerfile steps from least to most frequently changed

notes.summary: API returned 429 responses under load from the sync worker
notes.approach: Added exponential backoff with jitter and a shared token bucket
notes.outcome: No 429 responses during the load test
notes.learning: Retry with jitter so workers do not retry in lockstep

notes.summary: Daily report showed the wrong day for users in India
notes.approach: Stored timestamps in UTC and converted to the viewer timezone at display time
notes.learning: Convert time zones only at the edge

notes.summary: Documented OAuth scopes for the read-only token
Added a Postgres index for the entries list query
notes.outcome: List query uses the new index

notes.summary: Fixed OAuth redirect loop in the billing portal
notes.learning: Set the cookie domain from the public hostname

notes.summary: Docker image rebuilds were slow because dependencies reinstalled
notes.learning: Copy the lockfile before the source

notes.summary: Retry policy for the sync worker: three attempts with a fixed one second delay
notes.outcome: Worker retries failed requests on a fixed delay

notes.summary: Retry policy for the sync worker changed to exponential backoff with a longer final delay
notes.outcome: Worker backs off after each failed request; fixed delay removed
